question.text:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion A and the other is labelled as Reason R 

Assertion A: Hydrogen is an environment friendly fuel.

Reason R: Atomic number of hydrogen is 1 and it is a very light element.
In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below

options.text: A is true but R is false
Both A and R are true but R is NOT the correct explanation of  A
A is false but R is true

Both A and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi></math> are true and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi></math> is the correct explanation of A

solution.text:
No pollution occurs by combustion of hydrogen and it has very low density.
Combustion of hydrogen produces water by the following reaction:
2H2(g) + O2(g) →  2 H2O(g)
